name: yolo11n_vcsc_calibration_development_v1
purpose: Calibration-method decision gate only. Frozen YOLO11n; do not scale to 15 models from this config.

data.official_test_policy: Positive official test, official size XML subsets, and official negatives are evaluation-only. No test data or labels may affect calibration construction.

decision_rule.scale_if: VCSC has mean macro-domain Delta mAP50 at least 0.005 above Uniform, does not reduce full mAP50, and is no more variable than Uniform across calibration seeds.
decision_rule.modify_if: Absolute mean macro-domain Delta mAP50 advantage versus Uniform is below 0.005.
decision_rule.stop_if: VCSC macro-domain Delta mAP50 is at least 0.005 below Uniform or its sampling standard deviation exceeds Uniform by more than 0.005.
